c4.comment: Detection.md entry 7: `C4Context`, `C4Container`, `C4Component`, `C4Dynamic`, `C4Deployment`. rule 6: `C4Context`, `C4Container`, `C4Component`, `C4Dynamic`, and `C4Deployment`, in that order, read a header keyword not followed by a word character. Follows c4.md#the-top-level-context.

patterns.comment: A diagram comment has the mark %% and the text after it up to the line terminator as its value; U+2028 and U+2029 inside a diagram comment do not end it. Follows c4.md#comments.

Rule 2: title and accDescription, each followed by one whitespace character and nonempty text without #, ;, or LF, make their whole line-value unit. Quotes and percent pairs are text. The whole remainder of an accepted title line is its value; the excluded converted characters are not validated here. Directives inside titles are trivia within their values, including before the separator. Retain this local context: permits Notation whitespace, including line terminators, around the delimiter and preserves inline percent pairs in the value. Retain this local title form: uses exactly one Notation whitespace separator and preserves percent pairs in its line value. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. Follows c4.md#the-top-level-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Rule 3: accTitle and accDescr enter their value context at the colon, and accDescr enters its block context at the opening brace. A directive between two complete units is allowed. The keyword context reads either delimiter after whitespace and directives; bare words inside text contexts stay text. Retain this local context: permits Notation whitespace, including line terminators, around the delimiter and preserves inline percent pairs in the value. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. Follows c4.md#the-top-level-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Read the positional alias or endpoints without requiring surplus commas or arguments. Directives between the call keyword and opener keep their own scopes. Follows c4.md#rejections-outside-the-grammar and c4.md#calls-and-arguments.

Rule 7: The call keywords are tried in the listed order, each in exact case and not followed by a word character. A keyword context reads (, entering the argument context; ) at a unit start closes both contexts. Follows c4.md#the-top-level-context and c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.
Rule 8: { and } read their units. Each boundary keyword requires a body ending with }. Follows c4.md#boundaries.

c4-colon-value.comment: A colon enters the line-value context, whose value is the rest of the line after optional whitespace. Leave the following whitespace outside the begin match so a separator before a common comment remains available to #comment-line. Follows c4.md#title-and-accessibility-contexts and common.md#comment-lines.

c4-brace-value.comment: The description block reads through the first closing brace; interior opening braces and percent pairs are text. Leave the following whitespace outside the begin match so a separator before a common comment remains available to #comment-line. Follows c4.md#title-and-accessibility-contexts.

c4-string-argument.comment: Rules 3 and 4: ASCII spaces before a double quote are padding, including when directives separate them. A tab before a quote instead starts bare text. Read the padding separately so adjacent strings each use the shared string rule. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.

patterns.comment: Only ASCII spaces before a quoted argument are padding; global directives may separate these components. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.
In a quoted argument the next double quote closes the string; backslash does not escape it. Follows c4.md#strings-and-named-attributes.

c4-call-arguments.comment: Read the remaining argument units of each call. Follows c4.md#calls-and-arguments.

patterns.comment: Rules 3 and 4: ASCII spaces followed by a double quote enter a quoted argument, including an empty string. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.

Rule 6: Bare text takes the longest nonempty run of characters other than a comma, including whitespace, quotes, braces, ), and line terminators. A closing parenthesis after its beginning belongs to the value. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts and common.md#comment-lines.

c4-named-key.comment: Rule 5: ASCII spaces followed by $ enter the named-key context. After $, the key is every character up to the next =, including commas, ), whitespace, and line terminators, and may be empty. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. Follows c4.md#strings-and-named-attributes.

c4-comma.comment: Read a comma between arguments or in a null entry. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.
c4-comma.name: punctuation.separator.comma.mermaid

c4-name-argument.comment: Read one positional argument, preserving strings and named keys while scoping bare aliases and endpoints as element names. Follows c4.md#rejections-outside-the-grammar.

patterns.comment: Read the entire bare alias or endpoint, including quotes that do not delimit a string. Follows c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid
